summary: SAML attribute NameFormat case-folding causes intermittent role resolution failures for admin console in Private
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports intermittent 403s when attempting to access the admin console and perform SCIM operations. Failures began after IdP team rolled out a change to SAML attribute NameFormat and case usage.

Impact:
- Multiple Nimbus Health admins unable to open the Redwood admin console (403) ~20% of login attempts.
- Automated SCIM provisioning jobs intermittently fail with authorization errors.
- Affects Private deployment in their VPC; no public-facing traffic affected.

Environment:
- Private deployment (customer-managed control plane) in prod-us-east.
- Redwood auth version: v1.14.3 (saml-proxy v0.9.7).
- IdP: Vendor SAML provider (self-hosted) recently updated to canonicalize attribute names (NameFormat urn:oasis) and to lowercase attribute local-names on assertion generation.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Initiate SAML SSO to Redwood admin console using affected Nimbus admin account.
2) Observe redirect and SAML assertion posted to saml-acs endpoint.
3) Occasionally receive 403 from auth service with 'role resolution failed' logged.
4) Repeating login may succeed.
5) Run SCIM sync job using same service account and observe intermittent 403s in SCIM endpoint logs.
logs:
[auth-saml] 2026-03-10T08:12:34Z WARN role-resolver: attribute 'Role' not found after normalization
[proxy] 2026-03-10T08:12:34Z DEBUG saml-acs: received Assertion with NameFormat='urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:basic', attributes: { 'role': 'Admin' }
[auth] 2026-03-10T08:12:34Z ERROR permission-check: deny user 12345 reason='no-matching-role-binding'
[scim] 2026-03-10T08:15:01Z ERROR scim-sync: failed to update user reason='403 forbidden' request_id=abc-123
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-10T09:02:00Z: Reached out to customer for SAML assertion sample. Asked for exact raw assertion and IdP release notes.
Nimbus SRE (Customer) 2026-03-10T10:20:00Z: Shared two sample assertions (one successful, one failed). Mentioned IdP change to lowercase attribute names to conform to internal schema.

Daniel Kim (Auth ENG) 2026-03-10T12:00:00Z: Initial hypothesis - role resolver expects attribute local-name 'Role' (case-sensitive) or 'http://schemas.redwood.com/roles'. Lowercasing could break lookup when NameFormat is basic. Captured sample assertion and reproduced parse behavior locally.

Daniel Kim 2026-03-11T14:30:00Z: Temporary mitigation proposed - add a case-insensitive attribute lookup path plus NameFormat awareness. Preparing a short-lived policy that tolerates lowercased local-names for role resolution only in customer's tenant.
investigation_notes:
- Reproduced locally by posting the customer's failing assertion to dev saml-acs. Parser normalized attribute local names when NameFormat='basic' and lowercased values; current role lookup performs exact match against configured attribute name and mapped claims.
- Found that RBAC role-binding matching uses exact string keys from tenant configuration (case-sensitive).
- IdP release notes: 'attribute names will be normalized to lowercase to reduce duplication across systems' (this was deployed without upstream change notice).
- Risk: Global change to our attribute parser could impact other customers relying on case-specific attribute names.
- Short-term fix options: 1) Tenant-scoped tolerant lookup (preferred), 2) Global case-insensitive matching (riskier), 3) Ask customer to revert IdP change (burdensome).
- Correlated SCIM job failures to the same role resolution path used by service account exchange; service account assertions sometimes had attributes in different NameFormat (unspecified vs. basic), causing further mismatch.
root_cause: IdP started canonicalizing attribute local-names to lowercase while keeping NameFormat as basic. Redwood's role resolver performed strict, case-sensitive attribute name matching and did not account for variations in NameFormat normalization, causing lookup failures for role attributes and resulting 403s.
workaround:
Applied tenant-scoped tolerant attribute matching in the auth proxy for Nimbus Health: enabled case-insensitive attribute name lookup and accepted role attribute under both 'Role' and 'role' keys for this tenant. Deployed as a hotfix to the private control plane.
Customer reverted SCIM job frequency for now to avoid churn while hotfix rolled out.
resolution_notes:
Hotfix v1.14.4-rc deployed to customer's private control plane on 2026-03-11 22:10 UTC enabling NameFormat-aware and case-insensitive attribute lookup for role binding resolution scoped to tenant 'nimbus-health'. Post-deploy monitoring shows 0.5% auth failure rate (from ~20%).
Planned follow-up: include a config toggle in saml-proxy templates for NameFormat handling and document recommended attribute naming in the SSO onboarding guide.
next_steps: Produce and publish a short KB article for SSO onboarding documenting NameFormat and attribute name expectations.
Add a test to saml-proxy CI that exercises NameFormat=basic with mixed-case attribute names to prevent regressions.
Engineering: plan for opt-in global case-insensitive matching after product review (ENG-2745).
Customer: IdP will evaluate option to keep lowercase canonicalization but add an assertion transform to emit configured attribute alias 'Role'.
